per_case.what_fix_needed: Apply H2: cap the top posterior / hold residual probability whenever a decision-relevant uncertain{} that bears on the winning conclusion is still unobserved AND the engine is recommending the test that would resolve it. Here GU-TB should not be allowed to settle at 0.9924 while urine AFB/culture/NAAT and the tissue/cytology adjudication (the exact pathway the ground truth used to confirm CIS) are open and being recommended; capping (e.g. to a moderate ceiling until the adjudicating observation lands) keeps diagnosis(bladder_urothelial_carcinoma) alive on the differential instead of foreclosing it at P=0.0248, and stops the 'no kickback' false-certainty. This fix is surgical: it only bites when (a) an open uncertain{} maps to the top hypothesis and (b) a confirmatory next_step is recommended — both true here. Cases the engine already gets right, where no decision-relevant confirmatory uncertainty remains open (all adjudicating tests observed), have nothing to cap, so their top-1 ranking is unchanged. Secondary H1 tightening (merge the granulomatous/inflammatory positives — especially the reused tb_igra — so the 'this looks inflammatory' picture fires once) lowers the 0.99 saturation but does not by itself flip top-1, so H2 is primary.
